DESIGN CONTRACT / HTML-3

A small, consistent toolkit.

The palette is an original approximation inspired by banknote colour families. It implies no official endorsement.

DISPLAY / GEORGIA

Clarity has
character.

Georgia serif headings, system sans-serif interface. No remote font dependency. Main text 16–18 px; labels at least 14 px.

SPACE / SHAPE

Room to read.

8 px rhythm. 24–48 px sections. 16–24 px corners. 1 px ink outlines. Discovery permits offset edges; purchase and help use calm surfaces.

Desktop content up to 1200 px. Mobile gutters 20 px. Interactive controls at least 44 px high.

Light and dark themes

Use the theme toggle on any screen. Device preference supplies the initial theme; a choice persists on this device. Dark surface #1D1C20, panel #29272D, text #F7F4EC. Category accents retain dark ink. Print uses light colours.

Actions and fields

Primary actionSecondary action

Hint and error association sit next to the field.

Keyboard and responsive contract

Tab order follows the document. Focus has a visible outline; a skip link goes to main content. Native details, inputs and controls retain keyboard behaviour. Comparison tables use a labelled horizontal region on narrow screens; no critical terms are hidden in collapsed accordions. No decorative motion is required.
